steps.name: Destroyed VM Summary Ready
steps.description: Send email only when the accumulated destroy summary contains at least one VM.

conditions.condition: {{ (vars.destroyed_count | default(0) | int) > 0 or vars.send_destroy_notification == true or (vars.send_destroy_notification | string | lower) in ['true', '1', 'yes'] }}

steps.name: Finish Without Email
steps.description: Finish the workflow without sending an email when no VM was destroyed.

steps.name: Find Confirmed Destroyed VM Instances
steps.description: Load Destroyed-status records; Build Destroy Summary keeps only IDs from this run's expired candidates.

steps.name: Snapshot Expired Candidates
steps.description: Freeze expired candidate IDs and names before the destroy loop mutates records.

arguments.expired_candidate_count: {%- set fe = vars.steps.Find_Expired_VM_Instances | default([]) -%}{%- if fe is mapping -%}{%- set recs = fe.data.data | default(fe.data['hydra:member'] | default(fe.data | default([]))) -%}{%- else -%}{%- set recs = fe -%}{%- endif -%}{{ recs | length }}
arguments.expired_candidate_ids_json: {%- set fe = vars.steps.Find_Expired_VM_Instances | default([]) -%}{%- if fe is mapping -%}{%- set recs = fe.data.data | default(fe.data['hydra:member'] | default(fe.data | default([]))) -%}{%- else -%}{%- set recs = fe -%}{%- endif -%}{%- set ids = [] -%}{%- for rec in recs -%}{%- set _ = ids.append(rec['@id'] | string) -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ids | join('||') }}
arguments.expired_candidate_names_json: {%- set fe = vars.steps.Find_Expired_VM_Instances | default([]) -%}{%- if fe is mapping -%}{%- set recs = fe.data.data | default(fe.data['hydra:member'] | default(fe.data | default([]))) -%}{%- else -%}{%- set recs = fe -%}{%- endif -%}{%- set names = [] -%}{%- for rec in recs -%}{%- set _ = names.append(rec.name | string) -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ names | join('||') }}

steps.name: Wait Before Destroyed Query
steps.description: Allow CRUDhub to commit Destroyed status before the confirmation query.

Snapshot Expired Candidates -> Destroy VM Instance
Destroy VM Instance -> Wait Before Destroyed Query

Find Confirmed Destroyed VM Instances -> Build Destroy Summary
Build Destroy Summary -> Destroyed VM Summary Ready
Destroyed VM Summary Ready -> Notify Destroyed Expired
